prompt: A customer tried to return a delivery on the last day of the returns window and was turned away. Steps: with 20 mugs in stock, create an order for 2 mugs on Monday 4 March 2024, then place, pick, ship and deliver it the same day. The customer portal status says the order is returnable until 3 April 2024. On 3 April 2024, 30 days after delivery, booking the return is refused with the message that returns closed on 2024-04-03. Expected: the return goes through on 3 April, because day 30 after delivery is still inside the window; only from 4 April (day 31) should it be refused. Fix it and keep the existing tests passing (python -m unittest discover -s tests).
